#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Simple news digest generator.

Fetches RSS feeds, extracts a short summary for each article,
and writes each summary to a timestamped file in data/output/.
At least three files will be produced.
"""
import os
import sys
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime
import textwrap

# Ensure required third‑party package is available
try:
    import feedparser
except ImportError:
    subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "--quiet", "feedparser"])
    import feedparser

# Create output directory if it does not exist
OUTPUT_DIR = os.path.join("data", "output")
os.makedirs(OUTPUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# RSS feeds to fetch
FEEDS = [
    "http://rss.cnn.com/rss/edition.rss",
    "http://feeds.bbci.co.uk/news/rss.xml",
    "https://www.reddit.com/r/worldnews/.rss",
]

def summarize(entry, max_len=200):
    """Return a short summary of the RSS entry."""
    text = entry.get("summary") or entry.get("description") or entry.get("content", [{}])[0].get("value", "")
    if not text:
        text = entry.get("title", "")
    return textwrap.shorten(text, width=max_len, placeholder="...")

def main():
    file_counter = 0
    timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d%H%M%S")
    for feed_url in FEEDS:
        try:
            feed = feedparser.parse(feed_url)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Error parsing {feed_url}: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
            continue
        for entry in feed.entries[:5]:  # limit per feed to keep runtime short
            summary = summarize(entry)
            content = f"Title: {entry.get('title', 'No title')}\n"
            content += f"Link: {entry.get('link', 'No link')}\n\n"
            content += f"Summary:\n{summary}\n"
            filename = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, f"{timestamp}_{file_counter:03d}.txt")
            with open(filename, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                f.write(content)
            file_counter += 1
    print(f"Generated {file_counter} summary files in {OUTPUT_DIR}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
